history.summary: A Hanuman temple in the New Area/Okni locality of Hazaribagh (PIN 825301), located in front of the Pipal Tree on New Area Road, about 1.1 km from Hazaribagh Town railway station. It is managed by the Hanumanji Temple & Shiv Parivar Seva Dal (a registered body), which maintains an official page listing daily hours 06:00–13:00 and 15:00–21:00. No founding date or history was published; contact number +91 99312 15469 is listed on directories (verify).

name: Panchmukhi Hanuman Mandir
town_description: Hazaribagh is a city and the headquarters of Hazaribagh district in Jharkhand, about 92 km north of Ranchi on the Chotanagpur plateau at roughly 2,000 ft elevation. It is known as a former British-era cantonment town, the gateway to the Hazaribagh Wildlife Sanctuary, and for nearby sights such as Canary Hill and the Surajkund hot springs. The city is a regional trade and education hub for the North Chotanagpur division.
